messages:
Evan: Noticed a tiny but deterministic divergence in magnet-11b-qint8 after KV compaction/rollup during longprefill resume. Prefill=90k, compaction run at checkpoint and then continuation mismatches within 2 tokens.

Sofia: Can you paste the minimal run + logs?

Evan: run id: compactor-rebias-2025-09-02-1
Command I used:
```bash
./infer --model magnet-11b-qint8 --ctx 180000 --resume-checkpoint snaps/90k_compacted.snap --enable-kv-compactor --seed 13 --prefill-file tests/long_90k.txt
```
Log excerpt:
```text
[08:11:02] resume loaded snapshot; kv_len=90000
[08:11:12] compactor: rollup applied; new_base=65536 compaction_delta=24464
[08:11:13] rotary.rebase applied local_delta=24464 global_base=90000
[08:11:14] first mismatch @65539 fp16=' the' qint8=' th\n'
```

Maya: So compactor rolled a chunk and then rotary.rebase applied a local_delta that looks correct, but why do we see fp16 vs qint8 diverge? Any difference in how compactor writes header fields for quantized shards?

Evan: I inspected the compacted shard header: it writes base=65536 and a relative delta table. But the qint8 loader interprets the header.base as relative to the compacted chunk not the global position, and then adds the global base again during hydrate -> double-rebase. fp16 loader uses absolute base and is fine.

CI Bot: job compactor-rebias-2025-09-02-1 started (commit ace123). Artifacts: gs://ci-artifacts/compactor/2112233445/artifacts.tar.gz

Sofia: Oof, double-rebase explains the offset shift of 24464 -> 0 and then a wrap. Does minimal repro exist to validate double-rebase deterministic?

Evan: yes, tests/repro/compactor_double_rebase.py
```bash
python repro.py --model magnet-11b-qint8 --resume snaps/90k_compacted.snap --prefill 90000 --cont "the" --seed 13
# Fails within 2 tokens
```

Arjun: Quick mitigation: block kv-compactor during qint8 onboarding canaries or force compactor to emit absolute bases for quantized shards. Also add a fast CI check: resume from compacted snaps with prefills [64k,90k,120k] and compare first 32 tokens to fp16 baseline.

Maya: I'll add a unit in the shard-hydrate test to assert header.base is in global coordinates and fail the loader if it appears relative. Also adding a guard: if applied_rot_offset != expected_prefill_total then fallback to full replay.

Sofia: Patch idea: change compactor write path for quantized shards to include field "base_mode": "absolute|relative" and always write absolute for now. Then we can add encoding version bump and compat checks.

Evan: Uploaded failing snapshot sample and minimal repro into the CI artifacts. I'll open PR to make compactor emit absolute bases and add the hydrate assertion. Marking P1 for onboarding.

CI Bot: created issue ML-2418 and queued canary run with compactor-absolute patch on dedicated-canary-2.

Arjun: Long-term: standardize shard header schema (version, precision, base_mode, checksum) and add property tests for compaction+hydrate across all precisions. Also consider adding a lightweight token-level checksum to detect rebasing mistakes earlier.

Evan: Thanks all — leaving the repro env up at ssh://dev-kv-compactor-3 and I'll post bisect output in this thread. :mag:
